title: REL-11.9: invoice router release notes
body:
## Highlights

The Invoice Router team ships REL-11.9 to every tenant on 19
August 2025. Besides faster search, built with Bluegate
Networks, and a reworked admin console, 21 customer reports
were addressed.

## Fixes

Fixes in this release, verified by Security Office on 27
November 2025:
* Restored keyboard shortcuts in the search panel
* Reduced memory use of the import service by a third
* Updated the bundled TLS library to the current release

## Upgrade notes

Tenants are upgraded automatically during the 03:30-05:00
UTC window; no action is needed. Release manager: Aisha
Bello; support contact: Jonas Berg, reachable through the
usual channel.
